thread.title: IBD Stock Of The Day: Can Alarm.com Stock Buck Amazon, Google? | Investor's Business Daily

author: REINHARDT KRAUSE
title: IBD Stock Of The Day: Can Alarm.com Stock Buck Amazon, Google? | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Alarm.com ( ALRM ) is the IBD Stock of the Day as investors debate the cloud security firm's growth strategy amid the entry of Amazon.com ( AMZN ), Alphabet 's ( GOOGL ) Google, and Apple ( AAPL ) into the smart home market.
X Despite worries over competitive issues with Amazon, Google and Apple, Alarm.com stock is up nearly 27% from a year ago. Alarm.com stock jumped 7% on Aug. 8, breaking out of a flat base chart pattern.
The company reported second-quarter earnings growth of 55% to 34 cents a share. Revenue jumped 22% to $104.5 million. That easily topped estimates of 26 cents and $94.5 million.
Alarm.com stock has been trading in a tight range since the earnings day pop. That could be a bullish sign, or investors may be thinking about competition.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Cable TV firm Comcast ( CMCSA ) and Honeywell ( HON ) have pushed into home security services. So has AT&T ( T ), though its Digital Life business may soon be up for sale, said a report.
Alarm.com Stock Bucks DIY Threat The biggest new concern is what analysts call the "Do It Yourself" or DIY market.
Amazon, Apple and Google all sell products that consumer can self-install. Alarm.com, on the other hand, works with dealers. Its biggest customers are companies that sell alarm monitoring services.
"Alarm.com's core business momentum has remained consistent in the face of commoditizing DIY threats (that should not be dismissed), while incremental drivers through recent programs to penetrate small businesses, homebuilders, insurance carriers, and international markets should provide ample potential upside for some time to come," Jefferies analyst John DiFucci said in a recent note to clients.
But the competition is mounting. Google purchased smart device maker Nest in 2014. Google has been integrating its artificial intelligence software tools with Nest products.
Amazon Threat Growing With Ring And in February, Amazon acquired Ring, a maker of smart doorbells and video cameras.
Amazon has been integrating Ring technology with its Alexa smart home speaker platform. The e-commerce leader on Sept. 20 announced a new Alexa security guard service, along with a new $180 Ring camera.
On Alarm.com's second-quarter earnings call, though, management said it's in a different market than Amazon or Google. The company's partners are specialists in home security. They provide a higher level of security.
"We really think the market is pretty broad and there are different segments of the market," Alarm.com Chief Executive Steve Trundle said in a recent note to clients. "There are folks that are looking to add a device to their apartment, and then there are other families that are worried about the overall quality protection and safety in their property and want to really invest in their home."
A Different Consumer Market "We cater to the latter crowd," Trundle went on to say. "I think that's probably who we've been catering to through the years. And in that group, we haven't seen any changes in their behavior."
At Jefferies, DiFucci says Alarm.com aims to forge ties between its monitoring service providers with homebuilders and insurance companies. In the U.S., Alarm.com is working with national builder Toll Bros. ( TOL ). In Europe, Alarm.com is working with insurance firm Aviva.
Alarm.com in early 2017 acquired of the Connect and Piper business units from Icontrol networks for $148 million. One of Connect's largest customers is ADT's Pulse service, analysts say.
Raymond James analyst Adam Tindle said in a recent note to clients Alarm.com may be able to expand its relationship with ADT ( ADT ) as the latter aims to reduce capital expenses.
In the current quarter, analysts expect Alarm.com's profit to dip 7% to 25 cents amid growing investments. Revenue is projected to rise nearly 8% to $97 million.
Alarm.com stock added 0.7% to close at 57.22 on the stock market today .
